headline: Senate panel approves Trump's FCC nominee 15-0 as Democrats skip vote
summary: The Senate commerce committee, chaired by Ted Cruz, approved President Trump's FCC nominee 15-0 after all 14 Republican members attended while Democratic members were absent. One outlet describes Democrats as skipping the vote; another says they tried to prevent a quorum and accused the nominee, Thumann, of lying about not having worked on media issues.

claims.statement: The Senate commerce committee approved Trump's FCC nominee 15-0 along party lines after Democrats did not take part in the vote.

claims.statement: Committee Chair Ted Cruz began the Wednesday meeting to confirm Trump's nominee with a lopsided dais, as all 14 Republican members attended, including Majority Leader John Thune, while about a dozen seats were empty.

sources.quote: Senate commerce committee Chair Ted Cruz (R-TX) began a meeting Wednesday meant to confirm President Donald Trump's nominee to the Federal Communications Commission with a lopsided dais.
To his right sat all 14 Republican members of the panel, including Senate Majority Leader John Thune (R-SD). To his left were about a dozen empty chairs
